translationRepairs: The emperor had sent Cui Hanheng to Tibet to request troops; the Tibetan minister Shang Jiezan said, "By our law, we march only on the word of the chief commander named in the edict.
The emperor had sent Cui Hanheng to Tibet to request troops; the Tibetan minister Shang Jiezan said, "By our law, troops are sent only on the pledge of the minister in command of the army.
以主兵大臣為信 means the commanding minister's authority serves as the pledge; nothing in the source mentions being 'named in the edict'.
Huaiguang replied, "The army has only just come up—the horses are unfed and the men unfed. How can we fight so soon!"
Huaiguang replied, "The army has only just come up—the horses are unfed and the men have not eaten. How can we fight so soon!"
馬未秣，士未飯: duplicated 'unfed' is awkward; distinct verbs for horses and men.
Lu Zhi returned from Xianyang and memorialized, "The rebel Ci awaits execution, holding the palace precincts; his strength is spent and his aid cut off, prolonging his days in stolen life.
Lu Zhi returned from Xianyang and memorialized, "The rebel Ci has evaded execution, holding the palace precincts; his strength is spent and his aid cut off, prolonging his days in stolen life.
稽誅 means punishment has been delayed/evaded, not that Ci is awaiting execution.
The emperor said gladly, "When did you come back to us?"
The emperor said gladly, "When can you be back here?"
卿何時復至此 asks when Ma Xun will return (he then fixes a day and hour), not when he came back.
The emperor said with pleasure, "When did you return to us?"
The emperor said with pleasure, "When will you come back here?"
卿何時復至此 is a question about Ma Xun's future return, as s0131 shows.

In the third month, on the first day of the cycle, Yue feasted with Kong Chaofu; Xu complained bitterly about his younger kin, a nephew tried to restrain him, and Xu in anger killed the nephew, then said in remorse, "The Commissioner will surely kill me!"

In the third month, on the renshen day, the first of the month, Yue feasted with Kong Chaofu; Xu complained bitterly in front of his younger brothers and nephews, a nephew tried to restrain him, and Xu in anger killed the nephew, then said in remorse, "The Commissioner will surely kill me!"
壬申朔 is the renshen day, first of the month; 對弟侄有怨言 means complaining before his younger brothers and nephews.
